_usage: Gold-binding oracle mappings for KramaBench reruns. A concept maps to the FULL entity set a correct answer touches: source tables, measure columns, filter/scope columns, join keys, and population flags - NOT a single column. Every entry MUST be verified against the KramaBench reference (subtasks) or the failed run's trace BEFORE the rerun; a wrong table/column corrupts the measurement. See oracle_lakes.py for the schema and the two granularities (table-level = keep whole tables, column-level = keep only these columns).
